packs.title: Deutsch - alle Karten
packs.rights_holder: Prior99 und Mitwirkende, BixelPitch; nach Cards Against Humanity
packs.decision: Released for public, non-commercial download by the repository owner on 2026-10-28 under CC BY-NC-SA 2.0, the license of the Cards Against Humanity originals both sources derive from. Every card was approved as converted; no editorial changes.

packs.title: Nach Mitternacht (18+)
packs.decision: Original cards written for the repository owner, released by him for public download on 2026-10-28 under CC0 1.0. FSK 18 starts off on every X4. Card text lives outside git (packs.local/).

packs.title: Alles (Deutsch + Nach Mitternacht)
packs.rights_holder: Prior99 und Mitwirkende, BixelPitch; nach Cards Against Humanity; 0b-ivan
packs.decision: Deutsch - alle Karten and Nach Mitternacht merged into one pack by the repository owner on 2026-10-28, under CC BY-NC-SA 2.0 (the community cards' license; the own cards are CC0). FSK 18 starts off on every X4.

packs.title: Moralisch Bankrott (18+)
packs.decision: Original adult satirical cards written for the repository owner, and explicitly requested for in-game download on 2026-10-29. This is a first-party CC0 deck. The FSK 18 category starts disabled; the user must enable it.
